operations.details: Verified official EA first-return DSM 1m dataset.
First-return surface signal separated from bare-earth terrain.
Buildings, vegetation and vehicles rejected as ground elevation.
1m grid spacing not promoted to vertical accuracy.
Verified official EA first-return DSM 2m dataset.
2m first-return product kept as surface model.
Source survey +/-15cm RMSE retained independently of grid spacing.
Neither first-return DSM promoted to bare-earth parcel DTM.
Both EA first-return DSM URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No surface-object height substituted for parcel terrain result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
